description: SYNTHETIC: generated by src/recon/generator.py. One row per line of a per-MID statement file that arrived on _arrival_date (UTC).

fields.name: statement_id
fields.description: One statement file: stmt_<mid>_<yyyymmdd of arrival>.

fields.name: line_id
fields.description: ln_<payment_id>. One line per settled payment in v1.0.

fields.name: record_type
fields.description: SALE, the only type in v1.0.

fields.name: payment_id
fields.description: PSP payment reference. The matching key.

fields.name: captured_ts
fields.description: The PSP's capture time, UTC, whole seconds (Adyen: Creation Date).

fields.name: accounting_date
fields.description: The PSP's day for the sale: the capture time shifted by the MID's fixed UTC offset.

fields.name: gross_minor
fields.description: Settled gross amount in minor units.

fields.name: fee_minor
fields.description: Fee charged by the PSP, in minor units.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Settlement currency, equal to the MID currency in v1.0.

fields.name: _arrival_date
fields.description: Partition column: the UTC day the statement file arrived (accounting_date plus the lag).

fields.name: _source_file
fields.description: Landing file path, relative to the landing folder.
